description: Indexed catalogue filters: add composite + fulltext DB indexes to products table; update ProductController@index to use whereFullText (with LIKE fallback for SQLite tests) and a sort param; update API CatalogController to add price_min/price_max/shop_id filters and fulltext search.
steps: Create database/migrations/2026_10_13_000001_add_catalog_search_indexes.php. In the up() method on table 'products': add composite index ['is_active','category_id'], composite index ['is_active','price'], composite index ['shop_id','is_active'], and fulltext index on ['name','description']. Also add index on shops table column 'psgc_city_municipality_id' (NOT this migration — that is FEAT-002). Drop all four in down().

Modify app/Http/Controllers/Catalog/ProductController.php @index: (a) add 'sort' param to validation: nullable, in:relevance,price_asc,price_desc,newest. (b) Replace the LIKE search with: if (DB::getDriverName() !== 'sqlite') { $query->whereFullText(['name','description'], $search); } else { $query->where('name','like','%'.$search.'%'); }. (c) After filter clauses, apply sort: relevance = keep ->latest() but only when $search present; price_asc = ->orderBy('price'); price_desc = ->orderByDesc('price'); newest = ->latest() (default). Replace the hardcoded ->latest() at paginate time with the conditional ordering. (d) Pass 'sort' => $filters['sort'] ?? 'newest' back to the view.

Modify app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/CatalogController.php @index: (a) add price_min/price_max filters (same pattern as ProductController — where price >= / <=). (b) add shop_id filter: if ($shopId = $request->integer('shop_id')) { $query->where('shop_id', $shopId); }. (c) Switch the name search to fulltext with SQLite guard, same pattern as ProductController step above.

Add tests to tests/Feature/CatalogFilterTest.php: test_sort_by_price_asc_returns_products_ordered_by_price(), test_fulltext_search_returns_matching_product(). Use RefreshDatabase and follow the existing test style in that file.
acceptance_criteria: Migration runs without error: `php artisan migrate`
GET /search?q=mango&sort=price_asc returns products sorted ascending by price
GET /search?sort=newest returns products ordered by created_at desc (default behavior)
GET /api/v1/catalog?price_min=100&price_max=500 returns only products in that price range
GET /api/v1/catalog?shop_id=1 returns only products for that shop
All existing CatalogFilterTest tests still pass
New sort and fulltext tests pass
findings: Sort param accepted values: relevance, price_asc, price_desc, newest (default). DB driver guard pattern: `if (DB::getDriverName() !== 'sqlite')` used in both ProductController and Api/V1/CatalogController to gate whereFullText — falls back to LIKE for SQLite. Same guard used in migration 2026_10_13_000001_add_catalog_search_indexes to skip fulltext index creation on SQLite. The view now receives a 'sort' key alongside other filter vars. API CatalogController accepts price_min, price_max (cast to float via (float)) and shop_id (via $request->integer('shop_id')). All 6 CatalogFilterTest tests pass (3 pre-existing + 3 new: test_sort_by_price_asc_returns_products_ordered_by_price, test_sort_by_price_desc_returns_products_ordered_descending, test_fulltext_search_returns_matching_product).
